# TagTrack — Phygital NFC Habit Tracker

> Track your habits by touching real objects. Tap NFC or scan QR. Logged in 2 seconds.

TagTrack is a phygital (physical + digital) habit tracker for iOS.
It turns everyday objects into habit buttons using NFC tags and QR codes.
No need to open an app — just tap a sticker on your water bottle, gym bag, or pill box.
